n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (At 3:17 a.m., the House is quiet except for a rapid series of mouse clicks behind Kess’s door.)

n2.speaker: player
n2.text: (The door is open. Her ring light is off. The laptop is the only light in the room.)

n3.speaker: kess
n3.text: Oh, hey. Perfect timing. Tell me if this thumbnail says ‘urgent’ or ‘desperate.’

n5.speaker: player
n5.text: (The screen shows a refugee registry. Arrival dates. Species filters. Intake centers. Missing-person mirrors cached from six different cities.)

n9.speaker: player
n9.text: One tab is called ‘unidentified beastkin arrivals.’

n11.speaker: player
n11.text: (A payment receipt sits beside the search results. Archive access. More Gold than she admitted earning this week.)

n17.speaker: kess
n17.text: The one where this becomes sad.

n18.speaker: kess
n18.text: It’s not a big deal, okay?

choices.text: “It’s a big deal if it matters to you.”
(Turn the payment receipt face-down and sit on the floor beside the desk.) “Okay.”

press2.speaker: player
press2.text: You don’t have to tell me what you’re looking for.

press3.speaker: kess
press3.text: But I’m not allowed to call it nothing.

press4.speaker: player
press4.text: Not if you’re spending sleep and rent money on it.

press8.speaker: player
press8.text: (She minimizes the registry. Not closes. Minimizes.)

press9.speaker: kess
press9.text: Fine. It is a medium-sized deal.

patience5.speaker: kess
patience5.text: That sounds threatening when you say it like that.

patience6.speaker: player
patience6.text: (You stay on the floor. She keeps scrolling.)

patience7.speaker: kess
patience7.text: You’re not even going to pretend you came in here for something?

patience8.speaker: player
patience8.text: I came in here because somebody was typing like they were trying to win a fight.

n19.speaker: player
n19.text: (A result loads. Three lines. Wrong age. Wrong city. Wrong world of origin.)

n23.speaker: player
n23.text: How long have you been good at this?

n26.speaker: player
n26.text: (Another alert appears. Her hand moves to the mouse before she can stop herself.)

n28.speaker: player
n28.text: The same spam from outside the gate?

n29.speaker: kess
n29.text: Wow. Memory too. Terrible qualities in a landlord.

n34.speaker: player
n34.text: (At breakfast, the registry is open again. This time she does not minimize it when you walk past.)
